scope: Read-only review of installed Isaac Sim 4.5.0 Python source and archived G3-P2-2-R1 evidence; no current G3-P2-4 SimulationApp or physics run.

external_primary_references.relevance: Gravity, Coriolis and inertia inverse dynamics semantics, implicit drives and solver force contributions; this public SDK documentation is not proof of the exact bundled library version.

Incoming joint force is a step-average; projected components and unmodelled damping, friction, constraints and armature need careful interpretation; different SDK version, not proof of exact bundled implementation.
Projected joint force definition; different extension version, installed wrapper source takes precedence.

documented_api.position_and_velocity: Articulation view get_joint_positions/get_joint_velocities: (M,K), name or index selections. Actual current run timestamps, ordering, finite outputs and units remain runtime checks.
documented_api.mass_matrix: Articulation view get_mass_matrices -> get_generalized_mass_matrices. For fixed base shape (M,num_dof,num_dof); for floating base includes six base DOF. Expected 9x9 based on historical FR3, not a new runtime observation.
documented_api.gravity: get_generalized_gravity_forces returns gravity-compensating joint forces, via get_gravity_compensation_forces. Thus it corresponds to +g in conventional M qdd + c + g.
documented_api.coriolis: get_coriolis_and_centrifugal_forces returns Coriolis/centrifugal compensating forces via get_coriolis_and_centrifugal_compensation_forces, corresponding to +c in the conventional equation.
documented_api.measured_effort: get_measured_joint_efforts calls get_dof_projected_joint_forces; solver joint-force projection in DOF direction, not documented as an unconditionally clean actuator-only measurement. Moving-state sign and alignment must be checked; R1 static sign cannot be assumed for motion.
documented_api.applied_effort: get_applied_joint_efforts returns explicitly set joint efforts, not necessarily implicit position-drive output.
documented_api.acceleration: No joint-acceleration getter found in the inspected articulation.py wrapper. A causal measured-velocity derivative is a possible estimate, requiring known sample time, explicit age, initialization, and sensitivity analysis; it is not a direct acceleration measurement.
documented_api.view_access: The inspected single articulation wrapper does not expose the matrix, gravity and Coriolis methods as single methods; use the articulation view with initialized valid physics handle and validate output.

historical_dof_evidence.scope: G3-P2-2-R1 archived sign run only, not a G3-P2-4 runtime measurement
historical_dof_evidence.finger_coupling: For arm components of M qdd, retain all 9 columns and measured accelerations, or establish and validate stationary fingers before dropping cross-coupling.

inertia_warning.source: G3-P2-2-R1 sign_console.log lines 421-422; negative mass/possibly invalid inertia and small-sphere approximation reported by PhysX
inertia_warning.interpretation: Inertia approximation can affect mass-matrix and dynamic residual accuracy and prevents claiming calibrated real-FR3 dynamics. Consistency with the same PhysX backend can still be investigated; actual model validity is not established.
